detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Name one hour you kept before you call the week managed.

A busy colour-coded calendar is occupancy. Managed time is one hour you can point at that you actually kept.

1. Look at yesterday or today.
2. Write one hour you actually protected.
3. Empty? Put one hour on tomorrow now.
4. Protect it before you open email.

The calendar only counts when you kept an hour.

#focus #productivity
